mfscgiserv_user.description: User to run the moosefs-cgiserv daemon as.

mfscgiserv_group.description: Group to run the moosefs-cgiserv daemon as.

mfscgiserv_bind_host.description: Local address for the CGI service to listen on. 'any' for all interfaces.

mfscgiserv_bind_port.description: Port number for the CGI service to listen on.

mfscgiserv_root_path.description: Local path used as the HTTP document root for the CGI service.

mfscgiserv_daemon_opts.description: Additional daemon options passed to mfscgiserv.
